actions.name: menu
actions.description: What's on a kid's school menu on a day: lunch, or breakfast where the school has it ("what's for lunch tomorrow?", "what's Sam having for breakfast on Tuesday?").

date.description: The day they mean, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for the next school day.

who.description: The kid, by name, if they said one

actions.name: week
actions.description: A whole week's school menus, a day at a time ("what are the lunches this week?").

who.description: The kid, by name, if they said one

next.description: Next week instead of this one
